# Reditor

> Alternatives to iPhone apps (for when an app shuts down, gets expensive or does not fit), with prices, versions and privacy labels copied from the App Store on a stated date. Run by Saga Labs; when a Saga Labs app is an alternative it is one more option, not first by default, and the footer of every page names our apps.

## Apps on this site made by Saga Labs (everything else listed is not ours)

- [Dora](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6754180384?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): AI video and image generator for iPhone and doravideo.com; subscription with coins; no free video.
- [Pinku](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6754878073?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): private AI chat with open models that run on the device; free model, optional Pro.
- [Brainy](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1667947372?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): plain-language AI assistant with voice, camera, images and video; weekly or yearly plan.
- [Ask AI](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1662608035?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8&ppid=420fcaf3-b818-460e-a74f-1cb8fe2a787a): AI chat with several models in one app; a few free messages a day, Pro for the rest.
- [Photo Vault](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1532670722?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): photo and video vault with Face ID, no account and no data collected; Premium yearly or lifetime.
- [Crypton](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1143691286?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): crypto price and portfolio tracker with P&L per coin and widgets; free, optional account.
- [Drop](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1462269642?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): breathing sessions and nature sounds with a growing garden; free, Pro monthly or lifetime.
- [3 Tasks](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id1553693943?pt=118348020&ct=rd-llms&mt=8): to-do list of three tasks a day with a timer on each; free, one-time Pro.
